title: Sustainable recovery of high-purity nickel from real electroplating sludge via optimized leaching–precipitation process
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,49501-49515
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08573J, Paper
Open Access

The Anh Luu, Ai Quynh Nguyen, Van Doan Nguyen, Van Giang Le
A two-step leaching–precipitation process achieves >98% Ni recovery and high product purity from real electroplating sludge, demonstrating a scalable and eco-friendly metal-resource strategy.
